title: A Super Rare Baseball Card Is Up for Auction
summary:
One of the most famous baseball cards ever is for sale at an auction. People have already bid more than $1 million for it!

The card shows a player named Honus Wagner. It was made between 1909 and 1911. Heritage Auctions calls it the Holy Grail of baseball cards, which means it is something collectors want very badly.

Honus Wagner played shortstop for the Pittsburgh Pirates from 1900 to 1917. He won eight batting titles. In 1937, he was one of the first players picked for the Baseball Hall of Fame.

Why is the card so rare? Long ago, cards came with tobacco products. A legend says Wagner asked the company to stop making his card because it was used to sell cigarettes. So very few were made.

Bidding ends on October 25. The sellers think the card will sell for at least $3 million. Earlier this year, a similar Wagner card sold for more than $5.8 million.
why_it_matters: It shows that a small card from a hobby many kids enjoy can become a valuable piece of history.
